_comment: Reference values for ase-custom-calculator (ASE 3.23.0, Morse D_e=0.5 eV, a=1.5 /A, r_e=2.5 A, Cu5 cluster from start.xyz, BFGS fmax<0.05). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 oracle runs produced identical values (spread 0). final_energy_eV_ref is the fmax<0.05 stationary energy; tol 1e-3 covers the force-convergence slack. L4 by construction: hidden-geometry energy/force checks of the imported calculator class.
